overclaims: METR disclosed that OpenAI reviewed and approved publication under its access agreement.
checks.note: The statement excerpt and locator match, and axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews. Two problems. First, the limitation saying OpenAI reviewed and approved METR's publication is not backed by any evidence item. Second, e2's public excerpt shortens the frozen words 'However, Altman admitted GPT-5 had not reached that goal yet.' to 'GPT-5 had not reached that goal yet.' That drops the attribution to Altman, so the line reads as the Guardian's own judgement. 'That goal' also loses its referent, OpenAI's definition of AGI.
